title: Flovaで簡易ストーリーとキャラ設定を作ってSeedance 2.5に渡し、ショートアニメとして映像化する
content:
Flovaで簡易ストーリーとキャラ設定を作ってSeedance 2.5に渡し、ショートアニメとして映像化する  
FlovaのSkill「ストーリー動画制作」を選び、プロンプトを個別に試すより制作手順ごと渡してスタイル統一とカット間のまとまりを出す  
同じFlova Skill（制作フロー）を別テーマに使い回して次の制作を効率化する

en.content:
Create a simple story and character setup in Flova, pass it to Seedance 2.5, and turn it into a short animated video.  
Choose Flova’s Skill “Story Video Production,” and instead of testing prompts one by one, hand over the entire production workflow to achieve a consistent style and better cohesion between cuts.  
Reuse the same Flova Skill (production flow) for different themes to make the next production more efficient.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] This is actually a video of the production process (sped up)
👇This time I tried selecting Flova’s Skill called “Story Video Production”
https://t.co/cKhntfZyea
It’s a highly polished Skill and one I can definitely recommend👏

Rather than trying prompts individually, I felt it was easier to keep the style consistent by giving the Skill the whole production process, and the cuts seemed to flow together more naturally.
Since the same Skill can be reused for different themes, the workflow I created once should also be useful for future productions 🥳

ko.content:
Flova에서 간단한 스토리와 캐릭터 설정을 만들어 Seedance 2.5에 넘기고, 숏 애니메이션으로 영상화한다  
Flova의 Skill 「스토리 동영상 제작」을 선택해, 프롬프트를 개별적으로 시험해 보는 것보다 제작 절차 전체를 맡겨 스타일 통일과 컷 간의 일체감을 낸다  
같은 Flova Skill(제작 플로우)을 다른 테마에 재활용해 다음 제작을 효율화한다
